en.headline: Northeast New Territories landfill extension opens fully
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department said the extension began full operation on Sunday and will replace the existing site, due to close later this year.
body: The extension of the Northeast New Territories Landfill began full operation on Sunday and will take over as one of Hong Kong's main waste facilities, the Environmental Protection Department said.

The department said the existing landfill will stop operating later this year and will then be restored. The extension sits to the southeast of the original site and has a design capacity of about 19 million cubic metres.

Site formation, an impermeable liner, a surface-water collection system, and leachate treatment and landfill-gas management systems were completed in the middle of this year, the department said. Limited waste reception had already been tested, and operations were being moved across in stages.
The department said it would keep improving the extension's operations, environmental performance and safety, and would press on with the remaining restoration and greening of the original landfill.

zh.headline: 新界東北堆填區擴建部分今日全面啟用
zh.dek: 環保署宣布，擴建部分星期日全面啟用，接替原有堆填區；原址將於本年稍後停運並進行修復。
body: 環境保護署星期日宣布，新界東北堆填區擴建部分全面啟用，接替原有新界東北堆填區，成為本港主要廢物終端處理設施之一。
署方表示，原有堆填區將於本年稍後停止運作，並進行修復。擴建部分位於原有堆填區東南面，設計容量約1900萬立方米。
土地平整、防滲漏墊層、地面水收集系統，以及滲濾污水處理和堆填氣體管理系統等關鍵工程，已於今年中完工。署方說，擴建部分已開展有限度接收廢物的營運測試，並逐步把堆填作業遷移過去。
環保署表示，會繼續提升擴建部分的運作及管理水平，以及環境和安全表現，並全速推展原有堆填區餘下的修復及綠化工作。
